intro: Swimming is a low-impact exercise ideal for New Zealanders of all ages and fitness levels. Many NZ gyms offer pool facilities, including YMCA, Les Mills, and council pools. With prices starting from $15/week, it's an affordable way to stay fit and healthy. Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme can also help you save 40-70% on gym memberships.

sections.heading: Benefits of Swimming for Fitness
sections.body: Swimming is a great workout for the whole body, improving cardiovascular health, strengthening muscles, and increasing flexibility. It's also low-impact, making it easier on the joints compared to high-impact activities like running. In New Zealand, swimming is a popular recreational activity, with many gyms and pools offering swim classes, aqua aerobics, and lap swimming.

sections.heading: NZ Gyms with Pools
sections.body: Several NZ gym chains have pools, including Les Mills, City Fitness, and Jetts. YMCA and council pools are also popular options. When choosing a gym with a pool, consider factors like location, cost, and the types of swim classes and facilities offered. Some gyms may offer additional amenities like sauna, steam room, or hot tub.

sections.heading: Swimming Workout Routines
sections.body: To get the most out of your swimming workout, it's essential to have a structured routine. Start with warm-up exercises like leg swings and arm circles, followed by laps of freestyle, backstroke, or breaststroke. You can also incorporate interval training, sprints, and drills to improve technique and increase intensity. Many NZ gyms offer swim classes and personal training sessions to help you develop a customized workout routine.
list: Laps of freestyle, backstroke, or breaststroke (20-30 minutes)
Interval training, sprints, and drills (10-20 minutes)
